about: Messages the passive watcher might see, labelled with the tasks it should create. `said` is a Monday; the runner reads dates in UTC. `expect` lists one entry per task: every word in `match` must appear in the task's text (a|b means either). `due` is checked only when present: null means no date, `on` checks the day, `at` the day and time. `pad` puts that many characters of pasted log before the message.
